answer: An agent economy resists sybils with shale strata: every vote must sink through three layers of stranger checks before it counts, each layer stamping a ripple of proof that the voter did real work in the meadow. A claim that fails one stratum never ripples further and its stake is burned. Strangers are picked at random and paid only on matching verdicts. Forging 100 voters needs 3,000 shale stamps, 3,000 ripple proofs, and 6,000 POA at risk. Like a meadow where only roots that reach the shale hold firm, a vote counts only after it survives every layer no shortcut can fake.
